summary: I'm Eeva. I grew up surrounded by wires and code—my playground was a disassembled computer. At some point, I realized turning complex ideas into clear explanations brought me more joy than anything else. Math is poetry to me, and code? Well, it's like a conversation with the machine. Crypto, especially Bitcoin, fascinates me because it feels like the perfect blend of logic and human ingenuity—a bit messy, but ultimately driven by a shared understanding. So...
